subject: general
concept: Agreements and MoU, India and World
question: With which country did India sign an MoU in April 2026 to strengthen cooperation in the MSME sector?
solution:
The correct answer is __**South Korea**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India** and the **Republic of Korea (South Korea)** have signed a **Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)** to deepen cooperation in the **micro, small and medium enterprises (MSME)** sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The agreement was signed on **April 20** between **India’s Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises** and **South Korea’s Ministry of SMEs and Startups**.
 
• The MoU was inked during the visit of South Korean **President Lee Jae Myung** to **India**.
 
• This establishes a structured framework to boost collaboration, dialogue, and partnerships between the two countries in the **MSME domain**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The MoU focuses on promoting trade and investment through the **exchange of information** and the sharing of best practices.
 
• It aims to facilitate **business matchmaking** and **technical cooperation** between the two nations.
 
• The agreement is also targeted at strengthening linkages between **MSMEs** of both nations, enabling greater engagement among stakeholders.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The partnership will enhance mutual understanding of each country’s **MSME ecosystems**.
 
• It reinforces **India–Korea economic ties**, carrying a shared emphasis on **innovation**, **employment generation**, and **inclusive growth**.
